name: Ithlio Tomerro Maga Ager
original_name: イスティオ・トメロ・マガ・アグル
source: Isutio is the crown prince of Maga Aguru, a country of the magicians. He is cheerful, calm and hospitable guy, despite the fact that the stability and prosperity of a large and technologically advanced kingdom rests on his shoulders. In addition, he is familiar with Arcie, since they share some mutual obligations. And of course, he will not stand aside when a new war against the demons will begin.
